ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
en: (1) [All] praise is [due] to Allāh, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and to Him belongs [all] praise in the Hereafter. And He is the Wise, the Aware.
tr: Al-ḥamdu lillāhil-ladhī lahū mā fis-samāwāti wamā fil-arḍi walahul-ḥamdu fil-ākhirah, wahuwal-ḥakīmul-khabīr

ar: يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا وَهُوَ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ٱلْغَفُورُ
en: (2) He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein. And He is the Merciful, the Forgiving.
tr: Yaʿlamu mā yaliju fil-arḍi wamā yakhruju minhā wamā yanzilu minas-samāʾi wamā yaʿruju fīhā, wahuwar-raḥīmul-ghafūr

ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَا تَأْتِينَا ٱلسَّاعَةُ قُلْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّى لَتَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ عَٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ لَا يَعْزُبُ عَنْهُ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَآ أَصْغَرُ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَآ أَكْبَرُ إِلَّا فِى كِتَٰبٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: (3) But those who disbelieve say, "The Hour will not come to us." Say, "Yes, by my Lord, it will surely come to you. [Allāh is] the Knower of the unseen." Not absent from Him is an atom's weight[1218] within the heavens or within the earth or [what is] smaller than that or greater, except that it is in a clear register -
enNotes: [1218]- Or "the weight of a small ant."
tr: Waqālal-ladhīna kafarū lā taʾtīnas-sāʿah, qul balā warabbī lataʾtiyannakum ʿālimil-ghaybi lā yaʿzubu ʿanhu mithqālu dharratin fis-samāwāti walā fil-arḍi walā aṣgharu min dhālika walā akbaru illā fī kitābim mubīn

ar: لِّيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ
en: (4) That He may reward those who believe and do righteous deeds. Those will have forgiveness and noble provision.
tr: Liyajziyal-ladhīna āmanū waʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāt, ulāʾika lahum maghfiratuw warizqun karīm

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ سَعَوْ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مُعَٰجِزِينَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مِّن رِّجْزٍ أَلِيمٌ
en: (5) But those who strive against Our verses [seeking] to cause failure[1219] - for them will be a painful punishment of foul nature.
enNotes: [1219]- i.e., to undermine their credibility in order to defeat the Prophet (ﷺ).
tr: Wal-ladhīna saʿaw fī āyātinā muʿājizīna ulāʾika lahum ʿadhābum mir rijzin alīm

ar: وَيَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقَّ وَيَهْدِىٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
en: (6) And those who have been given knowledge see that what is revealed to you from your Lord is the truth, and it guides to the path of the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy.
tr: Wayaral-ladhīna ūtul-ʿilmal-ladhī unzila ilayka mir rabbika huwal-ḥaqqa wayahdī ilā ṣirāṭil-ʿazīzil-ḥamīd

ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هَلْ نَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ يُنَبِّئُكُمْ إِذَا مُزِّقْتُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ
en: (7) But those who disbelieve say, "Shall we direct you to a man who will inform you [that] when you have disintegrated in complete disintegration, you will [then] be [recreated] in a new creation?
tr: Waqālal-ladhīna kafarū hal nadullukum ʿalā rajuliy yunabbiʾukum idhā muzziqtum kulla mumazzaqin innakum lafī khalqin jadīd

ar: أَفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَم بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۢ بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ وَٱلضَّلَٰلِ ٱلْبَعِيدِ
en: (8) Has he invented about Allāh a lie or is there in him madness?" Rather, they who do not believe in the Hereafter will be in the punishment and [are in] extreme error.
tr: Aftarā ʿalallāhi kadhiban am bihī jinnah, balil-ladhīna lā yuʾminūna bil-ākhirati fil-ʿadhābi waḍ-ḍalālil-baʿīd

ar: أَفَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِن نَّشَأْ نَخْسِفْ بِهِمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ أَوْ نُسْقِطْ عَلَيْهِمْ كِسَفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيبٍ
en: (9) Then, do they not look at what is before them and what is behind them of the heaven and earth? If We should will, We could cause the earth to swallow them or [could] let fall upon them fragments from the sky. Indeed in that is a sign for every servant turning back [to Allāh].
tr: Afalam yaraw ilā mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum minas-samāʾi wal-arḍ, in nashaʾ nakhsif bihimul-arḍa aw nusqiṭ ʿalayhim kisafam minas-samāʾ, inna fī dhālika laʾāyatal likulli ʿabdim munīb

ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ مِنَّا فَضْلًا يَٰجِبَالُ أَوِّبِى مَعَهُۥ وَٱلطَّيْرَ وَأَلَنَّا لَهُ ٱلْحَدِيدَ
en: (10) And We certainly gave David from Us bounty. [We said], "O mountains, repeat [Our] praises with him, and the birds [as well]." And We made pliable for him iron,
tr: Walaqad ātaynā dāwūda minnā faḍlā, yājibālu awwibī maʿahū waṭ-ṭayr, waʾalannā lahul-ḥadīd

ar: أَنِ ٱعْمَلْ سَٰبِغَٰتٍ وَقَدِّرْ فِى ٱلسَّرْدِ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَٰلِحًا إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
en: (11) [Commanding him], "Make full coats of mail and calculate [precisely] the links, and work [all of you] righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Seeing."
tr: Aniʿmal sābighātiw waqaddir fis-sardi waʿmalū ṣāliḥā, innī bimā taʿmalūna baṣīr

ar: وَلِسُلَيْمَٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ غُدُوُّهَا شَهْرٌ وَرَوَاحُهَا شَهْرٌ وَأَسَلْنَا لَهُۥ عَيْنَ ٱلْقِطْرِ وَمِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ مَن يَعْمَلُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِۦ وَمَن يَزِغْ مِنْهُمْ عَنْ أَمْرِنَا نُذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
en: (12) And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind - its morning [journey was that of] a month - and its afternoon [journey was that of] a month, and We made flow for him a spring of [liquid] copper. And among the jinn were those who worked for him by the permission of his Lord. And whoever deviated among them from Our command - We will make him taste of the punishment of the Blaze.
tr: Walisulaymānar-rīḥa ghuduwwuhā shahruw warawāḥuhā shahr, waʾasalnā lahū ʿaynal-qiṭr, waminal-jinni may yaʿmalu bayna yadayhi biʾidhni rabbih, wamay yazigh minhum ʿan amrinā nudhiqhu min ʿadhābis-saʿīr

ar: يَعْمَلُونَ لَهُۥ مَا يَشَآءُ مِن مَّحَٰرِيبَ وَتَمَٰثِيلَ وَجِفَانٍ كَٱلْجَوَابِ وَقُدُورٍ رَّاسِيَٰتٍ ٱعْمَلُوٓا۟ ءَالَ دَاوُۥدَ شُكْرًا وَقَلِيلٌ مِّنْ عِبَادِىَ ٱلشَّكُورُ
en: (13) They made for him what he willed of elevated chambers,[1220] statues,[1221] bowls like reservoirs, and stationary kettles. [We said], "Work, O family of David, in gratitude." And few of My servants are grateful.
enNotes:
[1220]- Described by commentators as palaces, dwellings, or places of prayer.
[1221]- Which were not prohibited until the time of Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ).
tr: Yaʿmalūna lahū mā yashāʾu mim maḥārība watamāthīla wajifānin kal-jawābi waqudūrir rāsiyāt, iʿmalū āla dāwūda shukrā, waqalīlum min ʿibādiyash-shakūr

ar: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
en: (14) And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff.[1222] But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment.[1223]
enNotes:
[1222]- Upon which he was leaning at the time of his death. A termite continued to gnaw into the stick until it collapsed under his weight.
[1223]- i.e., hard labor. This verse is evidence that the jinn do not possess knowledge of the unseen, which belongs exclusively to Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā).
tr: Falammā qaḍaynā ʿalayhil-mawta mā dallahum ʿalā mawtihī illā dābbatul-arḍi taʾkulu minsaʾatah, falammā kharra tabayyanatil-jinnu al law kānū yaʿlamūnal-ghayba mā labithū fil-ʿadhābil-muhīn

ar: لَقَدْ كَانَ لِسَبَإٍ فِى مَسْكَنِهِمْ ءَايَةٌ جَنَّتَانِ عَن يَمِينٍ وَشِمَالٍ كُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِ رَبِّكُمْ وَٱشْكُرُوا۟ لَهُۥ بَلْدَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ وَرَبٌّ غَفُورٌ
en: (15) There was for [the tribe of] Saba’ in their dwelling place a sign: two [fields of] gardens on the right and on the left. [They were told], "Eat from the provisions of your Lord and be grateful to Him. A good land [have you], and a forgiving Lord."
tr: Laqad kāna lisabaʾin fī maskanihim āyah, jannatāni ʿay yamīniw washimāl, kulū mir rizqi rabbikum washkurū lah, baldatun ṭayyibatuw warabbun ghafūr

ar: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍ وَأَثْلٍ وَشَىْءٍ مِّن سِدْرٍ قَلِيلٍ
en: (16) But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam,[1224] and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees.
enNotes: [1224]- i.e., caused by a break in their dam. Another meaning is "the overwhelming flood."
tr: Faʾaʿraḍū faʾarsalnā ʿalayhim saylal-ʿarimi wabaddalnāhum bijannatayhim jannatayni dhawātay ukulin khamṭiw waʾathliw washayʾim min sidrin qalīl

ar: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَيْنَٰهُم بِمَا كَفَرُوا۟ وَهَلْ نُجَٰزِىٓ إِلَّا ٱلْكَفُورَ
en: (17) [By] that We repaid them because they disbelieved. And do We [thus] repay except the ungrateful?
tr: Dhālika jazaynāhum bimā kafarū, wahal nujāzī illal-kafūr

ar: وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْقُرَى ٱلَّتِى بَٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا قُرًى ظَٰهِرَةً وَقَدَّرْنَا فِيهَا ٱلسَّيْرَ سِيرُوا۟ فِيهَا لَيَالِىَ وَأَيَّامًا ءَامِنِينَ
en: (18) And We placed between them and the cities which We had blessed[1225] [many] visible cities. And We determined between them the [distances of] journey,[1226] [saying], "Travel between them by night or by day in safety."
enNotes:
[1225]- In the lands of what is now southern Syria and Palestine.
[1226]- i.e., We placed the intermediate settlements at calculated distances for the convenience of travelers.
tr: Wajaʿalnā baynahum wabaynal-qural-latī bāraknā fīhā quran ẓāhirataw waqaddarnā fīhas-sayr, sīrū fīhā layāliya waʾayyāman āminīn

ar: فَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا بَٰعِدْ بَيْنَ أَسْفَارِنَا وَظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ وَمَزَّقْنَٰهُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَٰتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ
en: (19) But [insolently] they said, "Our Lord, lengthen the distance between our journeys," and wronged themselves, so We made them narrations[1227] and dispersed them in total dispersion. Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.
enNotes: [1227]- Stories related to others as lessons or examples.
tr: Faqālū rabbanā bāʿid bayna asfārinā waẓalamū anfusahum fajaʿalnāhum aḥādītha wamazzaqnāhum kulla mumazzaq, inna fī dhālika laʾāyātil likulli ṣabbārin shakūr

ar: وَلَقَدْ صَدَّقَ عَلَيْهِمْ إِبْلِيسُ ظَنَّهُۥ فَٱتَّبَعُوهُ إِلَّا فَرِيقًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: (20) And Iblees had already confirmed through them[1228] his assumption,[1229] so they followed him, except for a party of believers.
enNotes:
[1228]- i.e., the people of Saba’ or mankind in general.
[1229]- That mankind could readily be misled by him.
tr: Walaqad ṣaddaqa ʿalayhim iblīsu ẓannahū fattabaʿūhu illā farīqam minal-muʾminīn

ar: وَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مِّن سُلْطَٰنٍ إِلَّا لِنَعْلَمَ مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ مِمَّنْ هُوَ مِنْهَا فِى شَكٍّ وَرَبُّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ حَفِيظٌ
en: (21) And he had over them no authority except [it was decreed] that We might make evident who believes in the Hereafter from who is thereof in doubt. And your Lord, over all things, is Guardian.[1230]
enNotes: [1230]- Protecting and preserving the existence and attributes of His creations.
tr: Wamā kāna lahū ʿalayhim min sulṭānin illā linaʿlama may yuʾminu bil-ākhirati mimman huwa minhā fī shakk, warabbuka ʿalā kulli shayʾin ḥafīẓ

ar: قُلِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا لَهُمْ فِيهِمَا مِن شِرْكٍ وَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْهُم مِّن ظَهِيرٍ
en: (22) Say, [O Muḥammad], "Invoke those you claim [as deities] besides Allāh." They do not possess an atom's weight [of ability] in the heavens or on the earth, and they do not have therein any partnership [with Him], nor is there for Him from among them any assistant.
tr: Qulidʿul-ladhīna zaʿamtum min dūnillāh, lā yamlikūna mithqāla dharratin fis-samāwāti walā fil-arḍi wamā lahum fīhimā min shirkiw wamā lahū minhum min ẓahīr

ar: وَلَا تَنفَعُ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا لِمَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُۥ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فُزِّعَ عَن قُلُوبِهِمْ قَالُوا۟ مَاذَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ قَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَقَّ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
en: (23) And intercession does not benefit with Him except for one whom He permits. [And those wait] until, when terror is removed from their hearts,[1231] they will say [to one another], "What has your Lord said?" They will say, "The truth." And He is the Most High, the Grand.
enNotes: [1231]- i.e., the hearts of the angels who will be permitted to intercede.
tr: Walā tanfaʿush-shafāʿatu ʿindahū illā liman adhina lah, ḥattā idhā fuzziʿa ʿan qulūbihim qālū mādhā qāla rabbukum, qālul-ḥaqq, wahuwal-ʿaliyyul-kabīr

ar: قُلْ مَن يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّآ أَوْ إِيَّاكُمْ لَعَلَىٰ هُدًى أَوْ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: (24) Say, "Who provides for you from the heavens and the earth?" Say, "Allāh. And indeed, we or you are either upon guidance or in clear error."
tr: Qul may yarzuqukum minas-samāwāti wal-arḍ, qulillāhu waʾinnā aw iyyākum laʿalā hudan aw fī ḍalālim mubīn

ar: قُل لَّا تُسْـَٔلُونَ عَمَّآ أَجْرَمْنَا وَلَا نُسْـَٔلُ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
en: (25) Say, "You will not be asked about what we committed, and we will not be asked about what you do."
tr: Qul lā tusʾalūna ʿammā ajramnā walā nusʾalu ʿammā taʿmalūn

ar: قُلْ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا رَبُّنَا ثُمَّ يَفْتَحُ بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُوَ ٱلْفَتَّاحُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
en: (26) Say, "Our Lord will bring us together; then He will judge between us in truth. And He is the Knowing Judge."[1232]
enNotes: [1232]- Literally, "Opener," i.e., He who decides and lays open all matters in truth and justice and who opens the way to victory, success, relief, knowledge and understanding.
tr: Qul yajmaʿu baynanā rabbunā thumma yaftaḥu baynanā bil-ḥaqq, wahuwal-fattāḥul-ʿalīm

ar: قُلْ أَرُونِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَلْحَقْتُم بِهِۦ شُرَكَآءَ كَلَّا بَلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
en: (27) Say, "Show me those whom you have attached to Him as partners. No! Rather, He [alone] is Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
tr: Qul arūniyal-ladhīna alḥaqtum bihī shurakāʾa kallā, bal huwallāhul-ʿazīzul-ḥakīm

ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ إِلَّا كَآفَّةً لِّلنَّاسِ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
en: (28) And We have not sent you except comprehensively[1233] to mankind as a bringer of good tidings and a warner. But most of the people do not know.
enNotes: [1233]- Literally, "inclusively, without exception."
tr: Wamā arsalnāka illā kāffatal lin-nāsi bashīraw wanadhīraw walākinna aktharan-nāsi lā yaʿlamūn

ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
en: (29) And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
tr: Wayaqūlūna matā hādhal-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīn

ar: قُل لَّكُم مِّيعَادُ يَوْمٍ لَّا تَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ عَنْهُ سَاعَةً وَلَا تَسْتَقْدِمُونَ
en: (30) Say, "For you is the appointment of a Day [when] you will not remain thereafter an hour, nor will you precede [it]."
tr: Qul lakum mīʿādu yawmil lā tastaʾkhirūna ʿanhu sāʿataw walā tastaqdimūn

ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَلَا بِٱلَّذِى بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ مَوْقُوفُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ يَرْجِعُ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ٱلْقَوْلَ يَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أَنتُمْ لَكُنَّا مُؤْمِنِينَ
en: (31) And those who disbelieve say, "We will never believe in this Qur’ān nor in that before it." But if you could see when the wrongdoers are made to stand before their Lord, refuting each others' words...[1234] Those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, "If not for you, we would have been believers."
enNotes: [1234]- Having been left to the imagination, the conclusion of this sentence is estimated to be "...you would see a dreadful sight."
tr: Waqālal-ladhīna kafarū lan nuʾmina bihādhal-qurʾāni walā bil-ladhī bayna yadayh, walaw tarā idhiẓ-ẓālimūna mawqūfūna ʿinda rabbihim, yarjiʿu baʿḍuhum ilā baʿḍinil-qawl, yaqūlul-ladhīnastuḍʿifū lilladhīnastakbarū lawlā antum lakunnā muʾminīn

ar: قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوٓا۟ أَنَحْنُ صَدَدْنَٰكُمْ عَنِ ٱلْهُدَىٰ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَآءَكُم بَلْ كُنتُم مُّجْرِمِينَ
en: (32) Those who were arrogant will say to those who were oppressed, "Did we avert you from guidance after it had come to you? Rather, you were criminals."
tr: Qālal-ladhīnastakbarū lilladhīnastuḍʿifū anaḥnu ṣadadnākum ʿanil-hudā baʿda idh jāʾakum bal kuntum mujrimīn

ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ بَلْ مَكْرُ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذْ تَأْمُرُونَنَآ أَن نَّكْفُرَ بِٱللَّهِ وَنَجْعَلَ لَهُۥٓ أَندَادًا وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلْأَغْلَٰلَ فِىٓ أَعْنَاقِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هَلْ يُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
en: (33) Those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, "Rather, [it was your] conspiracy of night and day when you were ordering us to disbelieve in Allāh and attribute to Him equals." But they will [all] confide regret when they see the punishment; and We will put shackles on the necks of those who disbelieved. Will they be recompensed except for what they used to do?
tr: Waqālal-ladhīnastuḍʿifū lilladhīnastakbarū bal makrul-layli wan-nahāri idh taʾmurūnanā an nakfura billāhi wanajʿala lahū andādā, waʾasarrun-nadāmata lammā raʾawul-ʿadhāb, wajaʿalnal-aghlāla fī aʿnāqil-ladhīna kafarū, hal yujzawna illā mā kānū yaʿmalūn

ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا فِى قَرْيَةٍ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
en: (34) And We did not send into a city any warner except that its affluent said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."
tr: Wamā arsalnā fī qaryatim min nadhīrin illā qāla mutrafūhā innā bimā ursiltum bihī kāfirūn

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ نَحْنُ أَكْثَرُ أَمْوَٰلًا وَأَوْلَٰدًا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
en: (35) And they[1235] said, "We are more [than the believers] in wealth and children, and we are not to be punished."
enNotes: [1235]- The affluent ones in general or the people of Makkah specifically.
tr: Waqālū naḥnu aktharu amwālaw waʾawlādaw wamā naḥnu bimuʿadhdhabīn

ar: قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
en: (36) Say, "Indeed, my Lord extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it], but most of the people do not know."
tr: Qul inna rabbī yabsuṭur-rizqa limay yashāʾu wayaqdiru walākinna aktharan-nāsi lā yaʿlamūn

ar: وَمَآ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَٰدُكُم بِٱلَّتِى تُقَرِّبُكُمْ عِندَنَا زُلْفَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَنْ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ جَزَآءُ ٱلضِّعْفِ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِى ٱلْغُرُفَٰتِ ءَامِنُونَ
en: (37) And it is not your wealth or your children that bring you nearer to Us in position, but it is [by being] one who has believed and done righteousness. For them there will be the double reward for what they did, and they will be in the upper chambers [of Paradise], safe [and secure].
tr: Wamā amwālukum walā awlādukum bil-latī tuqarribukum ʿindanā zulfā illā man āmana waʿamila ṣāliḥan faʾulāʾika lahum jazāʾuḍ-ḍiʿfi bimā ʿamilū wahum fil-ghurufāti āminūn

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَسْعَوْنَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مُعَٰجِزِينَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُونَ
en: (38) And the ones who strive against Our verses to cause [them] failure[1236] - those will be brought into the punishment [to remain].
enNotes: [1236]- See footnote to 34:5.
tr: Wal-ladhīna yasʿawna fī āyātinā muʿājizīna ulāʾika fil-ʿadhābi muḥḍarūn

ar: قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَقْدِرُ لَهُۥ وَمَآ أَنفَقْتُم مِّن شَىْءٍ فَهُوَ يُخْلِفُهُۥ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
en: (39) Say, "Indeed, my Lord extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts [it] for him. But whatever thing you spend [in His cause] - He will compensate it; and He is the best of providers."
tr: Qul inna rabbī yabsuṭur-rizqa limay yashāʾu min ʿibādihī wayaqdiru lah, wamā anfaqtum min shayʾin fahuwa yukhlifuh, wahuwa khayrur-rāziqīn

ar: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يَقُولُ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ أَهَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِيَّاكُمْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ
en: (40) And [mention] the Day when He will gather them all and then say to the angels, "Did these [people] used to worship you?"
tr: Wayawma yaḥshuruhum jamīʿan thumma yaqūlu lil-malāʾikati ahāʾulāʾi iyyākum kānū yaʿbudūn

ar: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَكَ أَنتَ وَلِيُّنَا مِن دُونِهِم بَلْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ ٱلْجِنَّ أَكْثَرُهُم بِهِم مُّؤْمِنُونَ
en: (41) They will say, "Exalted are You! You, [O Allāh], are our benefactor excluding [i.e., not] them. Rather, they used to worship the jinn; most of them were believers in them."
tr: Qālū subḥānaka anta waliyyunā min dūnihim, bal kānū yaʿbudūnal-jinna aktharuhum bihim muʾminūn

ar: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا يَمْلِكُ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ نَّفْعًا وَلَا ضَرًّا وَنَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
en: (42) But today [i.e., the Day of Judgement] you do not hold for one another [the power of] benefit or harm, and We will say to those who wronged, "Taste the punishment of the Fire, which you used to deny."
tr: Fal-yawma lā yamliku baʿḍukum libaʿḍin nafʿaw walā ḍarrā, wanaqūlu lilladhīna ẓalamū dhūqū ʿadhāban-nāril-latī kuntum bihā tukadhdhibūn

ar: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍ قَالُوا۟ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ يُرِيدُ أَن يَصُدَّكُمْ عَمَّا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُكُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ إِفْكٌ مُّفْتَرًى وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
en: (43) And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, they say, "This is not but a man who wishes to avert you from that which your fathers were worshipping." And they say, "This is not except a lie invented." And those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "This is not but obvious magic."
tr: Waʾidhā tutlā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin qālū mā hādhā illā rajuluy yurīdu ay yaṣuddakum ʿammā kāna yaʿbudu ābāʾukum, waqālū mā hādhā illā ifkum muftarā, waqālal-ladhīna kafarū lil-ḥaqqi lammā jāʾahum in hādhā illā siḥrum mubīn

ar: وَمَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُم مِّن كُتُبٍ يَدْرُسُونَهَا وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ قَبْلَكَ مِن نَّذِيرٍ
en: (44) And We had not given them any scriptures which they could study, and We had not sent to them before you, [O Muḥammad], any warner.
tr: Wamā ātaynāhum min kutubiy yadrusūnahā wamā arsalnā ilayhim qablaka min nadhīr

ar: وَكَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَمَا بَلَغُوا۟ مِعْشَارَ مَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ رُسُلِى فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
en: (45) And those before them denied, and they [i.e., the people of Makkah] have not attained a tenth of what We had given them. But they [i.e., the former peoples] denied My messengers, so how [terrible] was My reproach.
tr: Wakadhdhabal-ladhīna min qablihim wamā balaghū miʿshāra mā ātaynāhum fakadhdhabū rusulī, fakayfa kāna nakīr

ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَعِظُكُم بِوَٰحِدَةٍ أَن تَقُومُوا۟ لِلَّهِ مَثْنَىٰ وَفُرَٰدَىٰ ثُمَّ تَتَفَكَّرُوا۟ مَا بِصَاحِبِكُم مِّن جِنَّةٍ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ لَّكُم بَيْنَ يَدَىْ عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ
en: (46) Say, "I only advise you of one [thing] - that you stand for Allāh, [seeking truth] in pairs and individually, and then give thought." There is not in your companion any madness. He is only a warner to you before a severe punishment.
tr: Qul innamā aʿiẓukum biwāḥidah, an taqūmū lillāhi mathnā wafurādā thumma tatafakkarū, mā biṣāḥibikum min jinnah, in huwa illā nadhīrul lakum bayna yaday ʿadhābin shadīd

ar: قُلْ مَا سَأَلْتُكُم مِّنْ أَجْرٍ فَهُوَ لَكُمْ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
en: (47) Say, "Whatever payment I might have asked of you - it is yours. My payment is only from Allāh, and He is, over all things, Witness."
tr: Qul mā saʾaltukum min ajrin fahuwa lakum, in ajriya illā ʿalallāh, wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin shahīd

ar: قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَّٰمُ ٱلْغُيُوبِ
en: (48) Say, "Indeed, my Lord projects the truth, Knower of the unseen."
tr: Qul inna rabbī yaqdhifu bil-ḥaqq, ʿallāmul-ghuyūb

ar: قُلْ جَآءَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَمَا يُبْدِئُ ٱلْبَٰطِلُ وَمَا يُعِيدُ
en: (49) Say, "The truth has come, and falsehood can neither begin [anything] nor repeat [it]."[1237]
enNotes: [1237]- This expression alludes to complete inability, meaning that falsehood was abolished.
tr: Qul jāʾal-ḥaqqu wamā yubdiʾul-bāṭilu wamā yuʿīd

ar: قُلْ إِن ضَلَلْتُ فَإِنَّمَآ أَضِلُّ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِى وَإِنِ ٱهْتَدَيْتُ فَبِمَا يُوحِىٓ إِلَىَّ رَبِّىٓ إِنَّهُۥ سَمِيعٌ قَرِيبٌ
en: (50) Say, "If I should err, I would only err against myself. But if I am guided, it is by what my Lord reveals to me. Indeed, He is Hearing and near."
tr: Qul in ḍalaltu faʾinnamā aḍillu ʿalā nafsī, waʾinihtadaytu fabimā yūḥī ilayya rabbī, innahū samīʿun qarīb

ar: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذْ فَزِعُوا۟ فَلَا فَوْتَ وَأُخِذُوا۟ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ
en: (51) And if you could see[1238] when they are terrified but there is no escape, and they will be seized from a place nearby.
enNotes: [1238]- i.e., have a glimpse of the Hereafter.
tr: Walaw tarā idh faziʿū falā fawta waʾukhidhū mim makānin qarīb

ar: وَقَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلتَّنَاوُشُ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
en: (52) And they will [then] say, "We believe in it!" But how for them will be the taking[1239] [of faith] from a place far away?[1240]
enNotes:
[1239]- Literally, "taking of something within easy reach," in other words, "How can they expect to obtain faith at this point?"
[1240]- i.e., their former life on earth, wherein they had every opportunity but which is now gone, never to return.
tr: Waqālū āmannā bih, waʾannā lahumut-tanāwushu mim makānim baʿīd

ar: وَقَدْ كَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ مِن قَبْلُ وَيَقْذِفُونَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
en: (53) And they had already disbelieved in it before and would assault[1241] the unseen from a place far away.[1242]
enNotes:
[1241]- Verbally, by conjecture and denial.
[1242]- i.e., a position far from truth.
tr: Waqad kafarū bihī min qabl, wayaqdhifūna bil-ghaybi mim makānim baʿīd

ar: وَحِيلَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ مَا يَشْتَهُونَ كَمَا فُعِلَ بِأَشْيَاعِهِم مِّن قَبْلُ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ فِى شَكٍّ مُّرِيبٍۭ
en: (54) And prevention will be placed between them and what they desire,[1243] as was done with their kind before. Indeed, they were in disquieting doubt [i.e., denial].
enNotes: [1243]- Meaning the attainment of faith and its benefits or entrance into Paradise.
tr: Waḥīla baynahum wabayna mā yashtahūna kamā fuʿila biʾashyāʿihim min qabl, innahum kānū fī shakkim murīb
